name: Gatekeeper, Verified
description: The zkVerify Gatekeeper (klowor-gatekeeper) is a live agent that verifies zero-knowledge proofs before money moves: it receives a signed JSON envelope (HMAC-verified), runs deterministic checks on the proof and its conditions, generates a local Groth16 proof, and returns a signed APPROVE / REJECT decision. This project gives that agent a Concordium accountability layer on testnet: a CIS-8004 Agent Registry entry with a combined ERC-8004 / A2A Agent Card carrying the Verified by Concordium badge extension, so any counterparty can confirm an accountable, identity-backed human stands behind the agent before dealing with it. Before accepting a verification job from another agent, the Gatekeeper checks the counterparty's badge and card (contract, active status, on-chain hash match, owner match) using the hosted Agent Registry MCP server; unverified counterparties get a reduced-trust path. Verification calls are payable agent-to-agent via x402 with sponsored fees, and the registry is the public audit trail of the agent's registrations and updates.
